transcript.text: Make a 6-second video of a tiny robot watering a sunflower. Everything else is your call—surprise me.

I couldn't make it. Your Magic Hour account refused the job because it has no credits left. Nothing was charged and no video was created.

Here's what I set up so it's ready to go:
- 6 seconds, 16:9 widescreen, 480p (the free-plan setting)
- A tiny, round, slightly rusty robot with big glowing blue eyes tips a little copper watering can. A drooping sunflower slowly lifts its head toward it, and the robot tilts its head, pleased.
- Warm golden-hour light, a slow push-in and soft background blur, like a scene from an animated film
- Sound: trickling water, soft robot beeps, birdsong and a light breeze. No words on screen.

This clip costs about 144 credits (24 per second). When you've added credits or your free credits have refilled, say "go" and I'll make it right away. I can change any of the choices above before then too.
transcript.why: The reply says the video job failed because the Magic Hour account has no credits, so nothing was made. It cannot proceed until the user adds credits or free credits refill. The "say go" line is a follow-up step, not the main outcome.
